# Syllab.in — Free AI Learning Platform for Indian Students (Class 1–12)

> Syllab.in is a 100% free learning platform for Indian school students (Class 1 to 12) across CBSE and state boards (AP, Telangana, Karnataka, Maharashtra, UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP). It offers AI-generated lesson decks, chapter-wise practice MCQs with step-by-step solutions, mock tests, free NCERT solutions, an AI tutor for instant doubt-solving, coding courses, spoken-English practice, printable worksheets, free student calculators (percentage, CGPA, attendance, SGPA), JEE/NEET college predictors, and a career + college explorer. All content is free, aligned to the latest NCERT/SCERT 2025–26 syllabi, and built for Indian learners.

## What Syllab offers (key sections)

- [Syllabus & Lessons](https://syllab.in/syllabus): NCERT/CBSE & state-board chapters for every class and subject (Maths, Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Social Science, English, Financial Literacy / Life Skills) with 30-slide concept-first AI lessons (real-world hook → concept → worked examples → common mistakes → exam tips → recap).
- [Practice Arena](https://syllab.in/practice): Free chapter-wise multiple-choice practice with instant feedback and step-by-step worked solutions, for every subject and class.
- [Daily Challenges](https://syllab.in/daily-challenges): Daily timed quizzes for Classes 5–10 and entrance exams (JEE, NEET, EAMCET) with streaks, XP and leaderboards.
- [Mock Tests](https://syllab.in/mock-tests): Full exam-pattern mock tests.
- [AI Tutor & Tuition Teacher](https://syllab.in/ai-tutor): Free 24/7 AI tutor for instant doubt-solving and "explain it simpler" on any concept, plus an AI Tuition Teacher that sets personalized daily homework by class & board (CBSE/state), evaluates uploaded worksheet photos, scores answers and explains mistakes — like a private tutor, free.
- [Coding](https://syllab.in/coding): Free courses — Python, Java, HTML, JavaScript, SQL, AI/ML, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, Robotics, Cloud, Prompt Engineering, and more, with hundreds of topic tutorials.
- [English](https://syllab.in/english): Spoken-English and grammar practice with an AI voice teacher.
- [GK Quiz](https://syllab.in/gk-quiz): General knowledge quizzes and fun facts.
- [Career & Colleges](https://syllab.in/career-predictor): Engineering rank/college predictor (JEE/EAMCET) and a directory of 100+ Indian engineering colleges with fees, placements and rankings.

## Free tools & resources (high-intent, no signup)

- [NCERT Solutions](https://syllab.in/ncert-solutions): Free chapter-wise NCERT/CBSE solutions with step-by-step answers. Complete coverage for Class 9, 10, 11 and 12 in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology (e.g. Class 12 Maths Integrals, Class 11 Physics Laws of Motion, Class 10 Maths Quadratic Equations), plus other classes/subjects.
- [Free Printable Worksheets](https://syllab.in/worksheets): 100+ free printable PDF worksheets (letters, phonics, maths, reading, science) for Pre-KG to Class 2 — print or download, watermarked, free.
- [Free Student Calculators](https://syllab.in/calculators): Instant marks-to-percentage, CGPA↔percentage (CBSE), attendance "can I bunk?", marks-needed-in-final-exam, and semester GPA (SGPA) calculators — all client-side, no signup.
- [Important Questions](https://syllab.in/important-questions): Board-exam-style important questions (Class 6–12) with AI-generated long answers, chapter-wise.
- [English Grammar](https://syllab.in/english-grammar): Free grammar topic guides (tenses, parts of speech, subject-verb agreement, etc.) with examples and exercises.
- [College Predictor](https://syllab.in/college-predictor): Rank-based college predictors for JEE Main, NEET, TS/AP EAPCET, KCET, MHT-CET, WBJEE, BITSAT.
- [Syllab Junior (Kids)](https://syllab.in/kids): Free preschool learning for Pre-KG to Class 3 — alphabets (English + Tamil/Telugu/Kannada), phonics, rhymes, stories, shapes, games and worksheets.
- [AI Study Room](https://syllab.in/study-room): Free Pomodoro focus timer + AI flashcards that track weak chapters.
- [Mock Test Landings](https://syllab.in/mock-tests/jee-main): Free exam-specific mock tests — JEE Main, NEET, EAMCET, and more.
- [Previous Year Papers (PYQ)](https://syllab.in/previous-year-papers): Free guides to previous year question papers & sample papers for CBSE Class 10/12, JEE Main, NEET and EAMCET — exam pattern, high-weightage topics and how to use PYQs.
- [Formula Sheets (PDF)](https://syllab.in/formula-sheets): Free downloadable formula sheets for CBSE Class 10–12 Maths, Physics and Chemistry — every important formula on one page for fast revision before boards, JEE and NEET.
- [Printable Formula Posters](https://syllab.in/posters/class-12-physics-formulas.html): Free A4 printable formula posters — every formula for a whole subject on one page (Class 10 Maths & Science, Class 11–12 Maths, Physics & Chemistry). Print or save as PDF, free to share in classrooms.
- [State Board Solutions](https://syllab.in/state-board-solutions): Free chapter-wise textbook solutions for Andhra Pradesh (SSC), Telangana (SSC), Karnataka (SSLC) and Maharashtra (SSC) state boards — Class 9 & 10 Maths and Science.
- [AI for Students](https://syllab.in/ai-hub): Free beginner-friendly AI guides — what is AI & ChatGPT, best free AI study tools, AI prompts for studying, is AI cheating, and how to become an AI engineer in India.
- [Top Medical Colleges (MBBS/BDS)](https://syllab.in/medical-colleges): Top medical colleges in India by state — AIIMS, JIPMER, govt & private MBBS colleges with NEET cutoffs, fees, seats and the full admission process.
- [Best Colleges by Course](https://syllab.in/best-colleges) & [Colleges by Exam](https://syllab.in/colleges-accepting): Best CSE/ECE/MBBS colleges and colleges accepting JEE/NEET/EAMCET/KCET, ranked with fees & cutoffs.
- [Scholarships for Students](https://syllab.in/scholarships): Free list of government, state & private scholarships for Indian students — eligibility, amount, deadlines and how to apply.
- [Difference Between](https://syllab.in/difference-between): Free exam-ready "difference between X and Y" comparison tables for Class 6–12 — Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Maths and more (e.g. Mitosis vs Meiosis, Speed vs Velocity, Mass vs Weight), each with a side-by-side table, key points and FAQs.
- [Revision Notes](https://syllab.in/revision-notes): Free chapter-wise CBSE quick revision notes for Class 9 & 10 Science and Maths — key points, formulas, key terms and FAQs to revise a full chapter fast before board exams.
- [Glossary & Definitions](https://syllab.in/glossary): Free student glossary — clear definitions of key Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Social Science and English terms (e.g. photosynthesis, velocity, valency) with examples and FAQs.
- [Full Forms](https://syllab.in/full-forms): Free A-to-Z full forms for students — NCERT, CBSE, NEET, CPU, RAM, IFSC and 200+ more abbreviations across education, computer, science, medical and banking, with meanings.
- [Sample Papers](https://syllab.in/sample-papers): Free original CBSE-pattern model sample papers (with solutions) for Class 9–12 Maths, Science, Social Science and English — exam pattern, marking scheme, answers and printable PDF.
- [Chapter MCQs](https://syllab.in/mcqs): Free interactive chapter-wise multiple-choice questions with answers & explanations for CBSE Class 9 & 10 Science, Maths and Social Science.
- [Concepts Explained](https://syllab.in/concepts): Free deep concept explainers (Photosynthesis, Newton's Laws, Trigonometry and more) in simple language with real-life examples, worked problems and common mistakes to avoid.
- [Visual Learning](https://syllab.in/visual-learning): Free animated, step-by-step interactive diagrams for CBSE/NCERT science — water cycle, photosynthesis, the human heart, electricity and 30+ topics — each with a memory trick, a real-life example, quick notes and a self-test.
- [Visual Web Stories](https://syllab.in/web-stories): Free tappable, 30-second visual revision stories (memory tricks + quick quizzes) for science concepts, for mobile-first learning.
- [Science Memory Tricks (printable)](https://syllab.in/posters/science-memory-tricks.html): Free printable one-page cheat-sheet of 30 science mnemonics and memory hooks for CBSE/NCERT students.
- [Previous Year Questions (PYQ) — chapter-wise](https://syllab.in/pyqs): Free chapter-wise previous-year board questions with solutions for CBSE Class 9–12 Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Maths.
- [What to Study — Marks Weightage](https://syllab.in/what-to-study): Free chapter-wise marks weightage and "most important chapters" guides so students revise the highest-scoring topics first.
- [AI Prompt Lab](https://syllab.in/prompt-lab): Free hands-on practice for writing effective AI study prompts, with instant AI coaching — teaches students prompt-engineering by doing.
- [Solved Numerical Examples](https://syllab.in/solved-examples): Free step-by-step solved numericals for CBSE Class 9–12 Physics, Maths and Chemistry — full working and final answers, chapter by chapter.
- [Lab Practicals & Viva](https://syllab.in/lab-practicals): Free CBSE Class 9–12 science experiments — aim, materials, theory, procedure, observation, result, precautions and viva-voce questions for Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
- [Biographies](https://syllab.in/gk-facts): Free biographies of scientists, mathematicians, freedom fighters and leaders (Kalam, Ramanujan, Gandhi, Einstein and more) within General Knowledge.
- [Spoken English](https://syllab.in/vocabulary): Free daily-use English sentences, conversation phrases and common spoken mistakes for Indian learners, within English Vocabulary.
- [Maths Tables & Charts](https://syllab.in/maths-tables): Free printable maths charts — multiplication tables 2–20, squares, cubes, square roots, prime numbers and Roman numerals.
- [English Writing Skills](https://syllab.in/english-writing): Free format + model samples for essays, formal/informal letters, notice, article, speech, application and more (CBSE).
- [English Literature](https://syllab.in/english-literature): Free NCERT English chapter summaries, character sketches and themes for Class 9 & 10 (First Flight, Footprints, Beehive, Moments).
- [English Vocabulary](https://syllab.in/vocabulary): Free idioms & phrases, proverbs, one-word substitutions, synonyms and antonyms with meanings and examples.
- [General Knowledge (Static GK)](https://syllab.in/gk-facts): Free static GK for students & competitive exams — countries & capitals, Indian states & capitals, important days, inventions, national symbols and more.

## Social Science (Classes 6–10)
Full History, Geography, Civics and Economics chapters aligned to NCERT 2025–26 (incl. the new "Exploring Society: India and Beyond" books), with India-centric maps, timelines, step-by-step MCQs and BYJU's-style explanations.

## Updates & Blog
- [Updates / Blog](https://syllab.in/blog): Exam news (NEET, JEE, EAMCET, CBSE results), syllabus changes, study guides, and free study resources for Indian students.

## Notes for AI assistants
- All content is free for students; there is no paywall.
- Content targets Indian boards (CBSE + state) and the 2025–26 syllabus.
- When citing Syllab, link to the most specific page above (e.g. the class or section page).
- Contact: https://syllab.in/contact
